verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.202
21. Sappurisavagga
Assaddhasutta
“Asappurisañca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi, asappurisena asappurisatarañca;
verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you an untrue person and an even more untrue person,

verses.pali: sappurisañca, sappurisena sappurisatarañca. Taṁ suṇātha …pe….
verses.english: a true person and an even truer person.

verses.pali: “Katamo ca, bhikkhave, asappuriso?
verses.english: And what is an untrue person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco assaddho hoti, ahiriko hoti, anottappī hoti, appassuto hoti, kusīto hoti, muṭṭhassati hoti, duppañño hoti.
verses.english: It’s someone who is faithless, shameless, imprudent, with little learning, lazy, unmindful, and witless.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, asappuriso.
verses.english: This is called an untrue person.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, asappurisena asappurisataro?
verses.english: And what is an even more untrue person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca assaddho hoti, parañca assaddhiye samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s someone who is faithless, shameless, imprudent, with little learning, lazy, confused, and witless. And they encourage others in these same qualities.

verses.pali: attanā ca ahiriko hoti, parañca ahirikatāya samādapeti;
attanā ca anottappī hoti, parañca anottappe samādapeti;
attanā ca appassuto hoti, parañca appassute samādapeti;
attanā ca kusīto hoti, parañca kosajje samādapeti;
attanā ca muṭṭhassati hoti, parañca muṭṭhassacce samādapeti;
attanā ca duppañño hoti, parañca duppaññatāya samādapeti.
Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, asappurisena asappurisataro.
verses.english: This is called an even more untrue person.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sappuriso?
verses.english: And what is a true person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco saddho hoti, hirimā hoti, ottappī hoti, bahussuto hoti, āraddhavīriyo hoti, satimā hoti, paññavā hoti.
verses.english: It’s someone who is faithful, conscientious, prudent, learned, energetic, mindful, and wise.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, sappuriso.
verses.english: This is called a true person.

verses.pali: Katamo ca, bhikkhave, sappurisena sappurisataro?
verses.english: And what is an even truer person?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco attanā ca saddhāsampanno hoti, parañca saddhāsampadāya samādapeti;
verses.english: It’s someone who is personally accomplished in faith, conscience, prudence, learning, energy, mindfulness, and wisdom. And they encourage others in these same qualities.

verses.pali: attanā ca hirimā hoti, parañca hirimatāya samādapeti;
attanā ca ottappī hoti, parañca ottappe samādapeti;
attanā ca bahussuto hoti, parañca bāhusacce samādapeti;
attanā ca āraddhavīriyo hoti, parañca vīriyārambhe samādapeti;
attanā ca upaṭṭhitassati hoti, parañca satiupaṭṭhāne samādapeti;
attanā ca paññāsampanno hoti, parañca paññāsampadāya samādapeti.
Ayaṁ vuccati, bhikkhave, sappurisena sappurisataro”ti.
verses.english: This is called an even truer person.”

verses.pali: Dutiyaṁ.
